description.value: The International Friendship Garden & Cultural Gateway is a public garden in Abbotsford operated by the City of Abbotsford Parks, Recreation & Culture, celebrating cultural diversity through landscape design. Tagged in OSM with a fence barrier, it is a defined, enclosed attraction along George Ferguson Way. Touring cyclists riding through Abbotsford may find it a worthwhile rest or sightseeing stop in an urban park setting.
